A $100 micro-grant can fund roughly 30–40 nets through organizations like the Against Malaria Foundation, each protecting a family for years. The cost-effectiveness and impact are well-documented and measurable.

Given the emphasis on well-established, clearly measurable impact for a single, one-time grant, I'll direct the funds to the bednets.
